question: In which of the following articles, “Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institution” is mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 30.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 30 **of the Indian Constitution mentions the **right of minorities **to establish and administer **educational institutions.**
 
• This article gives the right to minorities, whether based on** religion or language,** to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.
 
• The purpose of this article is to protect the** cultural and educational rights of minorities** and ensure that they are not deprived of the opportunity to conserve their **language, script, or culture.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 29** of the Indian Constitution mentions the protection of the **interests of minorities, **including their right to conserve their culture.
 
• **Article 31** relates to the **right to property.**
 
• **Article 28 **deals with the **freedom of religious instruction.**
 
• **Article 30A** provides for the reservation of **seats in educational institutions** for socially and educationally backward classes of citizens.
